title: Verse 1
words: odēraguru halahuvalavu mūrḷgadidadanvaghutva kīrtiyadhā godemugilaṃcinoḷage tōruvakdu ṣēṃtaditi agurulaghutvaḍivaṃ
restored: guru halavu valavu mūroḷ kīrtiya mugilaṃcinoḷage tōruvadu agurulaghutva
translation: The teacher’s manifold strength in the three worlds, his fame appearing at the edge of the clouds, shows agurulaghutva.

title: Verse 2
words: behadhātrige bīḷamēlēḷasa atapēmahihḷka sbageyasitaṃ bāsanatēḷtṃge śaṃgeluvaṃtātd?hahundadaṇṇa nēmiyaēpū
restored: dhātrige bīḷ mēlēḷasa āyasitaṃ tēltaṃge śaṃke ēḷuvaṃtāda nēmiya
translation: Nemi’s doubt came to arise as though floating, wearied by falling to the earth and rising again.

title: Verse 3
restored: dēhadaṃga niraṃgavādiha rūpaṃgaḷa anaṃtava kāṇuvar āvina
translation: Who will see the countless forms that have become bereft of bodily limbs.

title: Verse 4
words: caśḷayātrega aidinarāva māradi saśidadhiṣiyā sarśktiyaśdhasivilladiruva varal?inagiga cakkussiri ēridarugarvavineṃṇa
restored: yātrege aidi narā māradi śaktiyilladiruvavaralli enagīga cakra siri ēridaru garvaviṃ
translation: Having reached the procession, the people on the path were among those lacking strength; now, for me, the splendour of the wheel rose through pride.

title: Verse 5
words: uādhapāparunammanim mayrvtalā āyadtatarella vītarā asvarga dhareyoḷiddaruṅlaṣēṃtu ādharege ṛṇiralavitaṃ
restored: pāparu namma nimmella vīta svarga dhareyoḷiddaru dharegella
translation: Sinners, our people and all of yours, had departed from heaven and were on earth, throughout the earth.

title: Verse 6

translation: The line refers to a blood-colored scripture and the greatness of Kurukshetra, but its intervening words do not yield a reliable literal reading.

title: Verse 7

restored: tammoḷagiruva ātma nele kāṇada māvam?ur yaśassal vākya tāge mata
translation: The unreadable passage appears to speak of one who does not see the soul dwelling within oneself, followed by words concerning fame and utterance; the surviving letters do not establish how those phrases connect.

title: Verse 8
words: cali citta sarvadu balidanksadiḷarārali magadargīteya gelu hātruli iḷivāgalātmana bala hevagajraḍiḷicci bandihanelesaṃdi
restored: citta sarvadoḷu balidaṃ gīteya tiruḷ iḷivāgal ātmana bala hēge baṃdiha nele
translation: The mind is strong among all; when the essence of the Gītā sinks in, there is the ground for how the self’s strength has arisen.

title: Verse 10

title: Verse 35
words: vavśanāgade kēḷunannu palarudamēṇavedarakatadēśavu kavimuyavida jñnavanōḍipuda lābaśyasaśabavaṇiyaḷidu ninnativdh
restored: vaśanāgade kēḷu nanna palaśavu kavida jñānava nōḍipuda lābhaśya ninna

title: Verse 39

translation: The Karaṇa Sūtra’s utterance mentions the teacher Vyāsa’s extraordinary quality and karma; the surviving letters do not establish how these are connected.

title: Verse 40

title: Verse 68

translation: Or, in the discourse on the substance standpoint, the soul is foremost; I say it does not fall to the earth.

title: Verse 69
words: ṃṭrārājipa kāvya nānevaiḍe barṭa jīpa dharṃdaṃte avathanaṭaroḷu samyaktva śuddhadścarakhapaṭa nava mūreṃde sātkh

title: Verse 70

translation: Rejoice in the twenty-seven-numbered wheel; believe the sound of the letters and numbers arranged within it to be a path.

title: Verse 71
words: papalu nitya sukha ninaga śuddhāhūdaḷuṭṭapiṃraruvankadeṇikeē parpake nara viśuddhigeṃhadivarartōśapanārukāraṇatmānā

title: Verse 72

title: Verse 73

title: Verse 74

title: Verse 431

first_draft: All things, perfect knowledge, and the quality connected with humility—these too belong to the poem of the one who rules the world.

first_draft: Rō; earth; Śreṇīka of the world; all; ten; the Jina’s teaching; chā; jiṣunita; a Vedic hymn; gītāra; yaśavādandāma.

first_draft: Karnata, Saṅgōyaraṇī, Śaṣēti, as far as Kashmir, mountain Pārvatī, Muḍiṃḷaṇada, Grēyakkhihūya.

first_draft: These ten virtues are the complete number; honour knowledge, cutting off, Siṃhavikrīḍita, austerity, the restrained person, and the partially restrained person.

first_draft: Obeisance; thus, with six verses as support, they bowed; one and nine.

first_draft: Three and five, good knowledge, Om, understanding, the perfected one: for the one without sin, one finger is reckoned as a Ṛg verse.

title: Verse 100
words: ṇāmaraśdathi arthāgamavaḷiśsādarumavarālśaṃkeuditaṃ tiriva vānañaravāhada naridarthatatsaṃrāya taśōvitva maryāde ṛkkiniṃr

title: Verse 101
words: maratde jñāna yōgāṃka casara gsavivitākariya ākupaniliteteyakālōdhadōagṣa iṣṭanunannavarbhaṭā jēthēkōmadila vāṇi vidhiyāge kama

first_draft: That knowledge, the number of yoga and its essence, the unresolved state, the desired letter, and the method of the speech in my lap.

title: Verse 102
words: maśōraṇajanitaduḥkhatāgadarārēru guranrśeya r sarvatu hoveraḍāyacarka tīnaka vidyādāna mahatṃha muṃmana kaḷeva savidhi vhiva budōṇi

first_draft: Do not touch the suffering born of death; in every way, the two that go and the threefold gift of learning are great, taking away the mind; we bear them according to a method.

first_draft: I read the mark of victory, the throat-born one, the excellent womb and the demoness; the characteristic is witness to all this reasoning.

title: Verse 8

translation: Devotion, knowledge, humility, instruction, right vision, and the desire for right conduct are excellent for the other world.
first_draft: Devotion, knowledge, humility and instruction belong to one who has become a teacher of right faith and is devoted to all right conduct.

first_draft: To the revered lord of the Siddhas, who is free from it, homage, reverend lord. Oṃ hrīṃ. Vaikriyika.

first_draft: To the venerable lord of the perfected ones, free from the name-forming karma of aggregation: hrīṃ.

first_draft: To the revered lord of the perfected ones, free from the āhāraka body-integration name-karma, homage. Om.

first_draft: Karnataka’s splendour, increased by Gāṅgeya; praise of the one who granted fearlessness has an inexpressible, shoreless quality.

first_draft: That, the passions, the Pāhuḍa treatise and the Pūrvas, having been seen by human beings, became a song of good knowledge fashioned by Hari.

title: Verse 100
words: ṭayaṭadaṃka guṇpayaṃ bhōgavisarōladamānakhayeaḷehaṃvasagaṃbhīralṇkluyē nāvapada aśaṃbhava jinaraṃka neku aidihēnē syajñārtīya pabda

first_draft: That number is full of virtues; the poison of sensual pleasure holds sway. The nine revered stations are profound indeed; the unborn Jinas are sacrificers.

first_draft: The honoured woman, with glory, care and courage, protects the sixth from the burning of the lac house, so they say.
